 sgl.

[]
a member of it. विश॑स्प॑ति m. E. of Indra & Agni;
 विशां पति
m. prince, king.

विशङ्क a. fearless, not afraid of (—˚), secure;
 n. adv.

1 विशङ्का f. hesitation, suspicion, doubt, fear,
apprehension.
विशङ्कट a. extensive, enormous, huge, awful, terrible.

विशङ्कित a. fearful, suspicious, uneasy about, anxious
over (acc. w. प्रति or —˚).
विशङ्क्य a. to be suspected or apprehended.

विषाद m. slackness, dejection, depression, aversion,
disgust.

विशदय् विशद˚यति cleanse, purify make clear or
explain.

विषय m. reach, sphere, domain, province, country;
 the
right place for (gen.);
 object, esp. of sense, pl. (sgl.) the pleasures
of sense or the external world. छन्दसि विषये in the sphere of i.e.
only in the Veda (g.). Adj. —˚ falling into the sphere of, belonging or
relating to. — Abstr. ˚ता f., ˚त्व n.

विशर॑ a. tearing asunder;
 m. a cert. disease.

विशरारु a. falling asunder, decaying, frail, abstr.
˚ता f.
वि॑शरीक m. N. of a cert. disease.

विशल्यकरण f. ई healing arrow-wounds, f. a
cert. medicinal herb.
विशसितृ m. who kills or cuts up (an animal).
विशस्तृ॑ m. who kills or cuts up (an animal).
विशाखदत्त m. N. of a poet.
विशातन a. (f. ई) & n. hewing down, destroying.
विशिष्टवर्ण a. & m. (of) a particular colour.
विशून्य a. quite void or empty.
विशूल a. having no spear or pike.

विशेषज्ञ a. knowing difference or different things;
critical, wise, clever.

विशेषतस् adv. according to the difference of (—˚);
especially, in particular.
विशेषमण्डन n. a quite peculiar ornament.

विशेषवन्त् a. doing or having something peculiar or
better.

विशेषिन् a. different from or superior to (—˚),
individual.
विशोक a. freed or freeing from grief.
विशोषण a. & n. drying up (tr. & intr.).
विश्प॑ला f. N. of a woman.

विश्रब्ध a. confident, fearless, secure;
 ˚— & n. adv.

विश्रब्धकार्य a. having a confidential or a candid
business.*
विश्रम m. ˚ण n. rest, repose, relaxation.

विश्रम्भ m. trust, confidence in (loc., gen., or —˚);
unrestrained behaviour, ease.

विश्रम्भिन् a. inspiring or enjoying confidence,
confidential.
2 वि॑श्रवस् a. famous, glorious, N. of a Ṛṣi.
विश्रान्ति f. rest, repose, cessation, end.

विश्रामस्थान n. the same;
 object of recreation.

वि॑श्रुत a. heard, learnt, understood, known as (nom.);
famous, renowned.

विश्लेषण a. dissolving, disuniting;
 n. = prec.

विश्व॑कर्मन् a. all-doing, all-creating;
 m. N. of a
world-creating genius (similar to & often identified with Prajāpati),
in l. l. the architect or artist of the gods.

विश्व॑कृष्टि a. dwelling among or known to all people,
common or friendly to all.

विश्वजि॑त् a. all-conquering;
 m. N. of a cert. sacrifice.
विश्व॑तस् adv. from or on all sides, all around.

विश्व॑तोमुख a. (having the face) turned everywhere,
facing all sides.
विश्व॑था adv. by all means, at all times.
विश्व॑दर्शत a. visible to all, all-conspicuous.
विश्व॑देव्य a. belonging or dear to all gods.
विश्व॑दोहस् a. milking or yielding all things.
विश्व॑ध adv. by all means, always.
विश्व॑˚धा adv. by all means, always.
विश्व॑धेन a. sating all with drink.
विश्वपि॑श् a. having all sorts of ornaments or beauties.

विश्व॑पेशस् a. having all sorts of ornaments or
beauties.
विश्व॑प्सु a. appearing in all forms.
विश्वमिन्व॑ a. impelling or moving all.

विश्वमूर्ति a. existing in all forms or whose form is
the universe.
विश्वयोनि m. or f. source or creator of the universe.

विश्व॑रूप (f. आ & विश्वरूपी॑) a. many-coloured,
multiform, manifold, various. m. E. of Viṣṇu, N. of a son of
Tvaṣṭṛ, of an Asura, & of sev. men.

विश्व॑वार a. containing or granting all goods or
treasures.

विश्व॑˚वार्य a. containing or granting all goods or
treasures.
विश्व॑शंभू a. causing welfare or happiness to all.
विश्वसत्तम m. the best of all (Kṛṣṇa).
विश्व॑ह (विश्व॑˚हा) adv. always, at all times.
विश्वाङ्ग॑ a. having all limbs, complete.
विश्वात्मन् m. the soul of the universe, E. of Viṣṇu.
विश्वाधिप m. the lord of the universe.
विश्वा॑मित्र m. N. of a celebrated Ṛṣi, pl. his race.

विश्वासपात्र n. ˚भूमि f. a trustworthy person
(lit. vessel & place for confidence).

विश्वासिन् a. the same;
 also trustful.
विश्वेश m. lord of the universe, e. of sev. gods.

विश्वेश्वर m. = prec. (f. ई);
 a man's name.

2 विष॑ n. venom, poison;
 adj. f. आ॑ poisonous.

विषकन्या f. venom-girl (said to cause the death of
her lovers).

विष˚कन्यका f. venom-girl (said to cause the death of
her lovers).
विषकुम्भ m. a jar of poison.
विषघात m. destroyer of poison, physician.
विषण्ण a. dejected, sad, out of spirits.
विषण्णरूप a. of a sorrowful aspect.
विषण्णवदन a. looking sad or dejected.
विषता f. ˚त्व n. the being poison.
विषदिग्ध a. smeared with poison, poisoned.
विषमय f. ई consisting of poison, poisonous.

विषमवृत्त n. an unequal metre (having different
verses).
विषमस्थ a. being in danger or difficulties.
विषम˚स्थित a. being in danger or difficulties.

विषमायुध m. E. of the god of love, lit. the odd
(i.e. five-) arrowed.

विषमेषु m. E. of the god of love, lit. the odd (i.e.
five-) arrowed.
विषमी@कृ make uneven or adverse, P. ˚भू.

विषयपराङ्मुख a. averse from the external
world.*
विषयवन्त् a. having an object, objective.

विषयसङ्ग m. addiction to sensual objects, ˚ज
adj. sprung.
विषयात्मक a. given to sensual pleasures.
विषयान्त m. the boundary of a country.

विषयिन् a. sensual;
 m. sensualist, materialist.
विषयोपसेवा f. indulgence in sensual pleasures.
विषवेग m. the effect of poison.
विषाग्नि m. burning (l. fire of) poison.

विषाणवन्त् a. having horns or tusks;
 m. boar.

विषाणि॑न् a. = prec. adj.;
 m. elephant.
विषादन a. & n. causing despondency or depression.

वि॑षित a. loosened, opened, unharnessed (lit. & fig.), let
free.

वि॑षुण a. various, changing (moon);
 averse, hostile.

विषुवत्संक्रान्ति f. equinox passage or the time
of it (cf. seq.).
वि॑षूचिका f. a kind of disease.
विषूची॑न a. going asunder, diverging, spreading.
विष्किर m. scratcher, a kind of bird.

विष्ट॑प् f. विष्ट॑प n. (m.) highest part, surface,
firmament, heaven.

विष्टम्भ॑ m. support, prop, obstruction, hindrance,
resistance.
विष्ट॑र m. a bunch of reed-grass etc. to sit upon.
विष्टार॑पङ्क्ति f. N. of a metre.
वि॑ष्टुत a. praised variously or abundantly.

वि॑ष्णु m. N. of a god;
 abstr. ˚त्व† n.
विष्णुचक्र n. the discus of Viṣṇu.
विष्णुदत्त a. given by Viṣṇu, m. a man's name.
विष्णुपुराण n. T. of a Purāṇa.
विष्णुमय f. ई coming from or belonging to Viṣṇu.
विष्णुरूप a. bearing the shape of Viṣṇu.
विष्णुशर्मन् m. N. of an author.

विष्वक्तन a. spread everywhere;
 numerous, abundant.
वि॑संदृश f. आ & ई unequal, inferior.

विसंधि a. having no joints (body);
 unallied.

विसंनाह^1 a. without a coat of mail.

विसर्प m. spreading about, a kind of inflammation (also
˚पिका f.).
विसारिन् a. coming forth, spreading, expanding.

वि॑सृष्टि f. letting go, emanation, creation, esp. in
detail.
विस्तार m. spreading, expansion, diffusion, specification.
विस्पष्टार्थ a. having a clear sense.
विस्फारित a. opened wide, torn asunder.
विस्र a. stinking of raw flesh.
विस्रगन्ध m. the stench of raw flesh.

वि॑स्रस्त a. fallen down or asunder, loosened, detached,
slackened, languished.
